symptoms: Prevention of ischaemic heart disease and atherosclerosis

management_steps.details: Oral, 10 mg at night (or 10 mg daily for stable angina).
Indicated for patients on protease inhibitors or high-risk patients failing to respond to lifestyle modification with dyslipidaemia on atazanavir/ritonavir.
